Shortlist volunteers and start intro calls

Send the sponsorship deck to the first round of leads

decisions.statement: IIT Madras works for both days. Malayaja and Srihari walked the lecture halls and the space for tutorials; power and seating are fine, and the open question is catering.
We have more volunteer interest than we can place right now, so we shortlist rather than assigning everyone, and we talk to people before putting them on anything.
Keynote outreach is a shared job. Everyone brings names and everyone sends emails, so nobody is a bottleneck.
Talk submissions go through our own pretalx instance rather than a hosted service, so we keep control of the data and the review workflow.
The budget is the version we take to sponsors. Everyone had input; Malayaja owns keeping it current.
We visit IIT Madras before committing to anything, rather than deciding from a floor plan.
The deck goes out only after the budget is in it, so sponsors can see what their money pays for.
Three sponsor tiers. The lowest one is free for non-profits and community groups, because we want them in the room rather than priced out.
SciPy India 2026 runs on 19 and 20 December, workshops on the first day and the conference on the second.
Volunteer sign-ups go through a form rather than email, so responses land in one place.
We need a sponsorship deck before approaching anyone, so that comes first and everything else waits on it.
